## What changed

Describe the user-visible outcome and the scenario it supports.

## Verification

List checks run, the evidence inspected, and anything that needs reviewer verification. For a UI change, include a screenshot. For a grading change, include an example input and the expected decision.

Link the affected operator guide chapter and describe how you tested its example, or explain why the guide is unaffected. The merger verifies the published page for the merged commit.

## Design decisions

For a material product, UX or architecture choice, link the numbered ADR and its dated decision-log entry. Name the prior decision it extends or replaces. For an implementation-only change, cite the existing decision when applicable.

## Pre-commit review

Summarize the independent security, reliability and code-quality reviews on the staged change. Include findings, fixes, verification and any unverified behavior.
